reason: The V1 contract requires the 100K-measured resource envelope to be compatible with 500K before promotion, but the existing estimator contains no prospectively frozen 500K resource budget or compatibility rule. Positive 100K byte counts are not evidence of 500K compatibility.

decision_separation.100k_measurement_architecture_qualificat: may PASS if all 100K population, QC, fragment-linkage, boundary and measured-resource checks pass
decision_separation.500k_promotion: must remain INDETERMINATE until a separately frozen resource-compatibility gate is bound
